title: How AvioBook builds turnaround insights from operational data with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
summary: AvioBook, a Thales Group Company, prototyped Connected Analytics on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to turn AvioBook Connect's operational data into plain-language, evidence-based answers for airline managers and dispatchers, helping them find and act on the causes of flight turnaround
reason: This is a vendor customer case study about AvioBook using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, not a new model, research paper, funding/M&A/product launch, policy event, or open-source release. No active rule covers customer usage stories.
